name: solvent-buffer-cryoprotectant-list
description: Chemical component dictionary (CCD) IDs the parsers drop as water, solvents, buffers, cryoprotectants or crystallization salts (solvents), keep as ligands flagged for review because they are often from the buffer but often real ligands (ambiguous), or drop unless a metalc connection joins them to a metal ion (keep_when_metal_linked, also on the solvents list). Reviewed by researchers on 2026-10-28 and 2026-10-29. See docs/cif-extraction.md.
